hudAtZeroFocusYou: At zero Focus you die and respawn, losing the XP you had gathered toward your next level.
hudEveryoneWhoTakesPart: Everyone who takes part in a fight gets XP — being close with an aura on counts. The red sword means you are in combat. Mobs stop regenerating for a moment after being hit.
hudGetCloseAndPress: Get close and press E when the badge lights up. Quests are offered and turned in through dialogue; J opens the journal.
hudGrantedAtCertainLevels: Granted at certain levels, dropped by some mobs, taught by some people (E when the badge appears), rewarded by quests.
hudHealthBarTitle: Focus — your health and everything you spend to act
hudLevelingUpGrantsSkill: Leveling up grants skill points. Spend them in the spellbook (B) with +. Higher levels cost more points; each skill has its own cap.
hudMostSkillsSpendFocus: Most skills spend Focus — the tooltip states every price. The basic Damage aura is always free: you are never left without an option.
hudMoveWithWasdOr: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. The minimap is north-up; its compass shows directions. The world is shared — everyone you see is really there.
hudOpenTheSpellbookB: Open the spellbook (B), click a skill, then a slot or its hotkey. Not while in combat.
hudRespecButtonTitle: Reset every skill to level 1 and refund all points
hudSkillKinds: Auras: slots 1–3, one active, switch with the hotkeys — also mid-fight. Passives: always on, all in parallel. Cooldowns (Q, R, F): fire once, then recharge — the cooldown belongs to the skill, not the slot. Besides your skills, everyone always has two utility buttons, free and unlevelled: Recall takes you back to your bound campfire, and Camp puts down a small fire that heals everyone standing in it for a short while. Both cast slowly and break if you move or get hit. Camp costs a charge — resting at a real campfire refills them, and you carry more of them as you level.
hudSomeAreasAreDark: Some areas are dark — bring a light aura, or a friend who carries one while you carry the damage. Filling roles for each other is the design. There is no PvP.
hudSpendCostTitle: {cost, plural, one {Costs # skill point} other {Costs # skill points}}
hudTheBarAtThe: The bar at the top is Focus — your health and everything you spend, in one value. At zero you die. It refills out of combat; getting hit pauses that for a few seconds.
hudXpBarTitle: Experience — fills up to your next level
hudYouFightWithAuras: You fight with auras: a circle around you. No targeting, no aiming — where you stand is the attack. Each aura picks its own targets inside its range, and most affect only a limited number at a time (usually the nearest). An active aura ticks on a steady rhythm — every tick applies its effect; the ring pulse and the pip on the slot show the beat. Enemy auras tick too: stepping out between beats is real play. Exactly one aura is active at a time. You start with Damage equipped.
